thumbnail.headline: OPEN CLAIM? BEFORE SALE
thumbnail.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original editorial background for a Houston home-seller article about selling with an unresolved property insurance claim. Landscape 1.9:1. A modest older single-story Houston brick house occupies the right half, with a small professionally secured blue tarp over part of a visibly weathered shingle roof, dry lawn and mature live oak, bright calm morning after repairs were paused. Realistic restrained damage, no disaster spectacle. House and roof details remain clear on right; left half quiet shaded yard for a later navy overlay. No people, addresses, numbers, paperwork, text, signage, logos, watermark. Illustrative fictional property, not a listing. Natural photographic texture, accurate residential construction.
